Q8110.reason: Metoprolol has reached the usual 15 mg IV maximum, so further beta-blockade is inappropriate; digoxin slows AV conduction without adding beta-blockade and suits a hemodynamically stable patient.

Q5969.reason: Under the common-law escape rule the robbery continues until the felon reaches a place of temporary safety, and he had not yet reached his hideout, so the child's death occurred during the felony and supports felony murder.

Q8505.reason: Naturalism holds that international law rests on universal, objective natural or moral rules, while positivism treats law as the product of state consent and interests.
